lines.text: Callback. A spell-checker for cultural references.
Every comic has had a reference die. The reference was fine. The room was wrong.
Paste what you'll say. Pick the room.
Every reference is checked against Clue's taste data.
Green lands. Yellow is flat. Red dies here.
Same set, in Boston, and it nearly flips. Dunkin' lands. Waffle House dies.
Back in Atlanta. Why does Tom Brady die?
Click one: its rank across eight cities.
Then swaps Atlanta actually loves, with the tags they share.
Fix my set is an agent that swaps what dies. It picks a quarterback for a guy who throws, and rewrites only that line.
Going on tour? Check one set against every city.
Keep what lands everywhere. Swap the rest, city by city.
Every verdict is a Clue call, and here's the receipt.
Every verdict is four Clue calls: search, city rank, age, and swaps.
